verdict.rationale: Crossplane documents Composite Resource Definitions that 'define schemas for composite resources', and it markets its declarative APIs as 'machine-readable'. That gives a thin indication that its APIs carry machine-readable schemas. Nothing in the evidence describes OpenAPI or an equivalent spec that a user can download or export. missing for 10: explicit OpenAPI/equivalent spec format, documented download/export mechanism, independent or hands-on corroboration.
